meta.name: My Little Lover - Minami Kun no Koibito
meta.description:
Shun'ichi Minami possesses good looks and does well academically in high school. Chiyomi Horikiri is a bright girl who likes dancing. They were childhood friends and also their first loves, but after Shun'ichi Minami's father disappeared they hardly talk. On a storming night, Chiyomi Horikiri has an argument with her parents over her future course and leaves home. While trying to avoid the rain, Chiyomi Horikiri wishes that she go back to her childhood. Suddenly, Chiyomi becomes 15 cm tall. Shun'ichi Minami happens to see tiny Chiyomi Horikiri. She tells him that she doesn't want anyone else to see her, and Shun'ichi Minami takes her his home.

Ended · First aired 10 Nov 2015 · Japan · Language: Japanese · 44 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: Japanese

videos.title: Long Forgotten First Love
videos.overview: Once childhood sweethearts, high school seniors Chiyomi and Shunichi have drifted apart. One day, she realizes she still has feelings for him.

videos.title: Under The Same Roof?!
videos.overview: Wishing she were little again, Chiyomi is transformed into a miniature version of herself. When Shunichi finds her, she begs him to keep her hidden.

videos.title: A Magical Love Mallet
videos.overview: Shunichi takes Chiyomi shopping. They sneak into a local shrine where a legendary sacred mallet may be the key to solving her "tiny" problem.

videos.title: Don't Give Up, Minami
videos.overview: Shunichi's mother and Chiyomi talk him into rejoining the kendo team for an important match. Meanwhile, a suspicious man snoops around his household.

videos.title: Chiyomi's Big Adventure
videos.overview: Chiyomi sneaks out to get some doll dresses from her house. When she returns to Shunichi's home, she finds a mysterious couple who might be burglars.

videos.title: I Know I'm Not Good Enough
videos.overview: Chiyomi secretly attends school but is seen by Riku. Later, Sayori stays over at Shunichi's house and sneaks into his room that night for a kiss.

videos.title: 18 Year Old Proposal
videos.overview: Chiyomi is discovered by Shunichi's grandmother, who thinks she's a legendary princess. Later, she tries to fix a marital problem between her parents.

videos.title: The Blue Fairy
videos.overview: Tomiko is hospitalized after she suddenly faints. Shunichi is relieved to hear she's OK but soon has cause for worry when Chiyomi goes missing.

videos.title: A Romantic Getaway for Two
videos.overview: After questioning Shunichi, Riku finds out the truth about Chiyomi. Shunichi and Chiyomi leave on a trip to a hot springs to turn her back to normal.

videos.title: Good-bye Chiyomi, Good-bye Minami
videos.overview: Shunichi and Chiyomi eagerly await the legendary sunrise at Cape Akebono. Later, on the way home, Shunichi is hit by a car and hospitalized.
